title: Personal Finance ETL
summary: Bank CSVs in, one clean ledger and monthly reports out — safe to re-run any time.
problem: Bank exports are messy, overlap between imports and mix internal transfers with real spending.
solution: Layered .NET CLI (Domain / Application / Infrastructure) with SQLite: canonical CSV mapping, stable transaction hashing for idempotent re-imports, transfer reconciliation, rule-based categories, recurring detection and Google Sheets sync.
result: Re-importing never duplicates data; core logic validated by 43 automated tests on synthetic fixtures.
